h1: Tinidee Hotel Bangkok Golf Club — The 4-Star Hotel Where You Wake Up to a Green Golf Course Outside Your Window
intro: If you want a hotel not far from Bangkok where you wake up to green fairways, with a pool to float in, a spa to unwind and spacious rooms to sleep well in — Tinidee Hotel Bangkok Golf Club is the first name local Pathum Thani travellers and golfers think of · It's a 4-star, 128-room hotel opened in 2018, set right beside Bangkok Golf Club in Bang Kadi on Tiwanon Road · Guests praise the spacious clean rooms, friendly staff, varied breakfast and the quiet resort-in-the-city feel · The trade-offs are that it sits outside the town centre, getting anywhere needs a car, and on nights with a function the music can run late · Rooms start from approx. ฿1,100/night.

body.html: Tinidee Hotel Bangkok Golf Club is part of the Tinidee group (MBK), built hand in hand with the Bangkok Golf Club course · Open since 2018, it has 128 rooms at 99/3 Moo 2, Tiwanon Road, Bang Kadi, Mueang Pathum Thani · Its main draw is the location flanked by the golf course — open the curtains in the morning and green fairways stretch out in front of you · For golfers who want to walk from their room to the tee, or anyone who simply wants open, green surroundings near Bangkok, this place hits the mark.

Rooms come in several tiers, from Superior, Deluxe and Premium Deluxe to Premium Deluxe Balcony with a balcony, plus a Junior Suite and a two-bedroom suite · They are done in calm wood-on-white tones with a sofa, fridge, TV and a bathroom with a separate bath and shower · Most guests agree the rooms are larger than expected, clean and the beds comfortable, with many looking out over the golf course · One thing to know going in: the building has been open since 2018, so some areas show a little wear, and a few reviews mention a noisy air-conditioner in some rooms — overall it's still a well-kept 4-star room that's worth the price.
"Very spacious, clean rooms with a lovely golf-course view · Staff smiling and friendly, varied breakfast · Quiet and relaxing — perfect for a break near the city without a long drive."

On facilities, Tinidee delivers a solid spread for its size · There's an outdoor saltwater pool, the D Health Massage spa, a gym, sauna, steam room, yoga classes and an outdoor tennis court · The Café Nidee restaurant serves both Thai and international dishes, with a breakfast many reviews call varied and tasty · The caveat to plan around is that on nights with a wedding or function in the hotel, the music can run late — a room near the function hall can disturb your sleep, so it's worth asking at check-in whether there's an event that night.

Be clear about the location before you book · The hotel is in Bang Kadi on Tiwanon Road, which sits outside the town centre and far from the train lines, so getting anywhere needs a car · It's about 25 minutes by road to Don Muang Airport, around an hour to central Bangkok depending on traffic, and 20–30 minutes to Future Park Rangsit and Talat Thai market · It's close to the Bang Kadi industrial estate, handy for anyone working or attending a seminar nearby · Parking is easy and driving yourself is simplest · The overall score sits around 8.5 from real guest reviews (Booking around 8.3 · Trip.com as high as 8.8), with the standout strengths being the golf-course view, spacious rooms and service.

Honestly, Tinidee Hotel Bangkok Golf Club is most worthwhile for golfers and anyone wanting a resort-style break near Bangkok · You get green views, a saltwater pool, a spa and spacious rooms at an affordable rate · But if your goal is sightseeing in Bangkok, shopping at Siam or easy train access, this location may be too far out · If you're on a budget and just need a place to spend the night around Rangsit–Pathum Thani, there are cheaper options · But if you want a 4-star hotel with a pool, spa and open, easy surroundings all in one place, this one does it well.

Tips from following the reviews here: request a room facing the golf course and away from the function hall for both the view and the quiet · If you're here to play, ask the hotel directly about a stay & play package — sometimes it beats booking the room separately · On long weekends and through the golf season (late rains to cool season) rooms sell out fast, so book ahead · And compare prices across Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before you book, as each platform moves differently.
